results.summary: Fixed all three leftovers from #178's second-pass review. (1) readAgentCounts (src/hook.js) now resets the suppressed-Stop streak to 0 on every E line, making suppression consecutive-per-wave instead of lifetime-per-attempt; fixture S X X X X E S now stands aside (new test). (2) subagentStopHook now tries CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR first whenever it's set and disagrees with the cwd (rather than cwd-first), fixing both the false leak-line print on claude-p children and the case where a child checkout has its own board-less .kanban/ and inherited KB_* env, which previously recorded `ended` into the wrong (child's) bookkeeping instead of the root's; new test covers the inherited-env child case. (3) Updated all docs that said 'two hooks' to say three: docs/harnesses.md (table + prose), docs/manual-mode.md, docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md, src/init.js, src/board.js. worker-identity.md's frontmatter now says it doubles as the SubagentStop reference page, and documents the CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR design dependency (spike-measured, job cadca6f1) plus the b-neg probe explicitly. Re-stamped the 6 wiki pages in scope that were stale from #178's edits (hook-install-shapes, worker-identity, operator-seat, review-loop, up-and-down, web-board) -- wiki-check went from 11 stale pages to 5 (the remaining 5 are pre-existing staleness outside this task's file scope, e.g. architecture/overview.md, adr-004, auto-merge.md, planning-commands.md, update-notice.md).
